bio.text: Nancy Gutierrez is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 18, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.
According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Gutierrez was first elected in 2022 and is a public school teacher and a member of the Tucson Education Association.
The profile says Gutierrez has lived in Tucson with husband Andy and their two daughters since 2007 and has taught yoga in Tucson since 2008.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 18 (candidate-submitted statements)
